intervals.label: proposed to the J-PARC programme advisory committee
intervals.quote: The experiment was proposed to the J-PARC program advisory committee in 2009.

intervals.label: approved (stage-2) and under construction
intervals.note: Stage-2 approval by KEK in 2019 (conceptual design report 2012, technical design report 2015, review 2016). The J-PARC release of August 2026 reports that the H2 experimental area was completed in FY2024 and in operation since FY2025, and that cooled muons were accelerated to 0.3 MeV there in June 2026 (target: 4 MeV around 2027-28).
intervals.quote: With positive recommendations from the review committee and PAC, the experiment received the stage-2 status, a final stage of approval, from KEK in 2019.

intervals.label: start of the measurement (planned, late 2020s)
intervals.note: Schedule, not an event; the collaboration's own wording is "the late 2020s".
intervals.quote: The international collaboration has been preparing for the experiment aiming to start the experiment in the late 2020s.

name: J-PARC muon g-2/EDM (E34)
notes: Official site pages (schedule page) are in Japanese; the overview page is in English.
The date of the press release is taken from its URL (2026/08); the page text does not print a day.

physics_goals.quote: We aim to perform ultra-precision measurements of g-2 and electric dipole moment (EDM) at J-PARC by using a new method completely different from the existing ones.
physics_goals.value: Measure the muon anomalous magnetic moment and electric dipole moment with a new, independent method using a cooled and accelerated low-emittance muon beam

summary.plain: A planned experiment at J-PARC in Japan that will store cooled and accelerated muons in a compact magnet to measure their magnetic anomaly and electric dipole moment by a method completely different from the Fermilab and Brookhaven experiments. Its beamline and apparatus are being built.
summary.technical: J-PARC E34: re-accelerated thermal muon beam (factor 1000 smaller emittance), 3 T compact storage-ring solenoid (one twentieth the size of the Fermilab ring), tracking of decay positrons; goals a_mu statistical 450 ppb, systematic below 70 ppb, EDM 1.5 x 10^-21 e cm. Stage-2 approved 2019; H2 area in operation since FY2025.
